title: Sentri
summary_html:
This article is about a character from the Ultima game series. For the manga character from Ultima: The Fall of Magincia, see Rani Sentri.

Sentri [sahn-tray], also known as Santre, is a recurring character. First appearing in Ultima II, he is a frequent comrade in arms to the Avatar and a native of Earth.[1]
